chapterTitle: Chapter 21 Carboxylic Acid Derivatives: Nucleophilic Acyl Substitution Reactions
title: Problem 21-24

pages.text: PROBLEM 21-24 Kevlar, a nylon polymer prepared by reaction of 1,4-benzenedicarboxylic acid (terephthalic acid) with 1,4-benzenediamine (p-phenylenediamine), is so strong that it’s used to make bulletproof vests. Draw the structure of a segment of Kevlar.
